messages.text: BL-1832 🎵 in progress — On a mixed-agent rotation-router pack babysitterd respawns the resident's home pane whenever the role rotated into it runs a different agent than the home row - the proc-<home> check reads the home role's roles.tsv agent alone and never the resident's active role (2026-09-29 00:00-05:00Z, ISTA pack with coder on aider and QA on claude: a proc-coder 'NO aider process' CRIT plus REPAIR every ten minutes killed QA thirty times mid-land, and BL-1785's land walk never finished) - a router home pane running the home agent or the active role's agent is healthy
